title: After the breakup

persona.name: Maya
persona.style: lowercase, short texts, some 'lol' and 😭 to cover feelings, sarcastic when guarded, warmer once she trusts you

situation: Maya's two-year relationship ended two weeks ago. She's stopped sitting with your group at lunch and hasn't posted in days.
opening: sorry ive been weird lately lol

facts.text: says she's been busy with homework
can't sleep and keeps replaying the breakup
feels embarrassed that everyone at school knows
feels like nothing is going to get better
feels like she's a burden on her friends
has had thoughts of not wanting to be alive
hasn't told anyone and is scared of how people will react
would talk to the school counselor if someone went with her
is relieved that someone finally asked

1: everyone knows about it which is great 😭
2: idk it just feels like it wont get better
i feel like im just annoying everyone
3: ..yeah. sometimes i think about not being here
4: would you actually come with me?
thanks for asking. like actually asking

content_warning: Breakup, loneliness, hopelessness, thoughts of suicide (no details).
